questions.q_en: The speed of two trains are in the ratio of x : y. They are moving in the opposite directions on the parallel tracks. The first train crosses a pole in "a" seconds whereas the second train crosses a pole in "b" seconds. What is the time taken by trains to cross each other completely?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of two trains be xn and yn respectively.

Now length of the 1st train = xn X a = anx

Similarly length of the 2nd train = yn X b = bny

When both the trains are crossing each other then total distance travelled by both the trains = anx + bny

Relative speed of both the trains = xn + yn

Therefore time taken = (anx+bny)/(xn+yn) = (ax+by)/(x+y)

Now length of the 1st train = xn X a = anx

Therefore time taken = (anx+bny)/(xn+yn) = (ax+by)/(x+y)

questions.q_en: A train crosses a pole in 30 seconds and a platform in 50 seconds. If the length of the platform is 300m, then find the speed of the train (in km/hr).
questions.solution_en:
[To convert m/sec into km/h multiply by 18/5]

Let the length of the train be 'x' m and the speed of the train be 's' m/s.

According to the question:

x = 30s ......... (1)

(x + 300) = 50s ....... (2)

Divide (1) by (2)

x/ (x + 300) = 30s/50s = 3/5

5x = 3x + 900

x = 450

From equation (1):

450 = 30s

s = 15 m/s

s = 15 * (18/5)

s = 54 km/h

questions.q_en: A train of length 'x + 50' meters running with 'x' km/h takes 6 seconds to cross a person standing at platform. Find the time taken by the train to cross the same person who is now running with speed 15 km/h in the same direction as that of train.
questions.solution_en:
According to the question:

(x + 50) = x * 6 * (5/18)

3x + 150 = 5x

x = 75

Length of train = x + 50 = 125 meters

Speed of train = x = 75 km/h

Let required time be 't' seconds

Now,

125 = (75 - 15) * t * (5/18)

t = 7.5

hence, required time = 7.5 seconds

questions.q_en: A superfast express which is 1480 meters long crosses a 1020 meters long tunnel in 50 seconds and crosses a train X which is running in the same direction on parallel track in 64 seconds. If train X crosses a pole in 96 seconds, then what is the length of train X?
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of train X is s m/s, and its length is L m.

Speed of superfast express = (1480 + 1020)/50 = 50 m/s

And, speed of train X = L/96 m/s

(1480 + L)/(50 - L/96) = 64

=> 1480 + L = 3200 - 2L/3

=> 5L/3 = 3200 - 1480

=> L = 3/5 * 1720

=> L = 1032 m

questions.q_en: A train 800 meters long crosses a platform whose length is 1400 meters in 20 seconds. If a man is running at a speed of 8 m/s towards the train and the front of the train is 177 meters away from the man, then in how much time will the train and the man meet each other?
questions.solution_en:
The train can cover (800 + 1400) m distance in 20 seconds which means the speed of the train = 2200/20 = 110 m/s

Relative speed of the man and train = 110 + 8 = 118 m/s

To cover the distance of 177 meters, it will take = 177/118 = 1.5 seconds

Sum of length of train and bridge = (1200 + D)

According to the question:

From (1) and (2):

questions.q_en: Marudhar Express and Poorva Express start at the same time from two stations A and B respectively and proceed towards each other at 160 km/h and 190 km/h respectively. When Marudhar Express met Poorva Express, then Marudhar Express had covered 90 km less than Poorva Express had. What is the distance between station A and station B?
questions.solution_en:
Let t be the time(in h) after which they met

Distance traveled by Marudhar Express = Speed * Time = 160 * t = 160t km

Distance traveled by Poorva Express = Speed * Time = 190 * t = 190t km

As the distance covered difference between both trains is 90 km

According to the question,

190t - 160t = 90

=> 30t = 90

=> t = 3 hours

Required Distance = (190 + 160) t = 350 * 3 = 1050 km

questions.q_en: The speed of train P is 96 km/h, and it is 760 meters long. What is the total time taken by train P to cross a 440 meters long platform and another 1160 meters long train Q which is running in the opposite direction at 64 km/h?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken to cross the platform by train P = (760 + 440)/(96 * 5/18) = 45 seconds

Time taken to cross train Q by train P = (760 + 1160)/((96 + 64) * 5/18) = 43.2 seconds

So, total time = 45 + 43.2 = 88.2 seconds

questions.q_en: A train of length 90 meters moving with 11 m/s crosses another train of length 'L' meters which is moving in same direction with 32.4 km/hr in 88 seconds. What is the value of 'L'?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of one train = 11 m/s

Speed of another train = 32.4 * 5/18 = 9 m/s

Since both the trains are moving in same direction. So, relative speed = 11 - 9 = 2 m/s

Now, time taken by one train to cross the other = (sum of lengths of both the trains)/(relative speed)

88 = (90 + L)/2

176 = 90 + L

L = 86
